reason: Adopt Parlant v3.3.2 as the authoritative Relationship Journey and Goal graph engine for Yance. Parlant owns journey graphs, conditions, transitions, progress, session processing, completion/backtracking/skipping and per-relationship session/event history. Yance remains a thin desktop/runtime adapter: one hidden Parlant Agent per relationship, guarded relationship-to-Agent/Session mapping, existing Workspace projection, credential reference handling and final reply/send authority. The Python sidecar is built from exact mature OSS inputs, binds loopback only, disables Parlant data collection, persists beneath the Yance data root, and ships with a pre-materialized offline dependency environment rather than resolving Python dependencies at application startup.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Apply the repository normalizeChangedFiles contract: require exact repository-relative normalized paths, discard invalid paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing. This is the workPackageChangedFilesSha256 contract used by shared/release/implementationBranchPolicy.js.

parlant.integration: official Parlant Python SDK/server source at the exact commit; no fork and no copied Journey state machine

uv.role: build/sealing time only; uv must not be required by the shipped application at startup

pythonBuildStandalone.role: prebuilt CPython 3.12.13 runtime materialized into the Windows Parlant resource bundle

providerBoundary.credentialFlow: Yance credential authority -> Electron main -> Parlant child process environment

mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: No usable pre-materialized Parlant runtime is a causal RED; Yance must fail closed/degrade rather than silently bypass goal steering
Any Parlant listener that is not loopback-only is RED
PARLANT_DATA_COLLECTION must be forced false for the Yance-owned child process; inherited or enabled data collection is RED
OPENROUTER_API_KEY plaintext reaching renderer state, persistent Yance state or logs is RED
A relationship must never see or activate another relationship's Parlant Agent, Journey or Session
Goal create/edit/delete must be authoritative in Parlant rather than a parallel Yance goal graph
Goal pause must use Parlant native Session manual mode and resume must use native auto mode rather than a Yance pause state machine
Every real incoming customer event used for goal steering must enter the corresponding Parlant Session
Journey processing must produce the goal-aware reply candidate consumed by the existing Yance reply-decision chain
Parlant must never bypass Yance final reply decision or existing channel send authority
Restart must retain Parlant-owned Journey and Session state beneath the Yance data root
Application startup must not require online Python dependency resolution, pip install, uv sync, Git checkout or system Python
Provider or Parlant runtime failure must surface an explicit degraded/error state and must not silently fall back to ordinary non-goal prompting
Exact Parlant, uv, python-build-standalone and CPython provenance/license evidence plus deterministic runtime SBOM must be complete before GREEN
Windows x64 portable runtime must be built from the exact sealed OSS inputs and pass an offline startup/import/health closure without build tools present in the runtime bundle
The final implementation changed-path set must remain within these 20 exact paths and retain SHA-256 e9cdb1ac7c250c235b7b6f595c3b9a2e5856d9852cdf34aa3b1f5ec81e62cab6
Independent exact-Head review must have zero unresolved P0/P1 findings before implementation merge
